hypothesis: N=P**e, e>=2 integer, P minimum big-endian bytes all <=127. All a=1..i=9 except any ONE alias may independently be zero. Whole original or reverse-symbol DBBI/FAED.
caveat: A conjectured use of prime numbers as exponents, generalized to all integers. Not modular exponentiation/RSA, not arbitrary byte encodings.
upperBound: e<=floor(log2(max N)); any larger e requires P<2 and cannot yield N>1.
